title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Hard Rock Hotel & Casino, Las Vegas | 2003
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at The Joint at the Hard Rock Hotel & Casino in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA, on 30 August 2003.

It was the 29th show by the eighth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 35 dates between July and September 2003.

Starr had previously performed at The Joint on 13 March 1999 and 17 June 2000. Paul McCartney performed there on 19 April 2009.

The eighth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Paul Carrack: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • John Waite: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, guitar, bass, harmonica, flute
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion
